# function: generate_crn

CRNs are in the format `${Provider}|${Account}|${Region}|${ResourceType}|${ResourceID}`. A full CRN for a resource can be found in the Falcon console within Cloud Security under Assets -> Cloud Inventory.



## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
generate_crn(cloud_provider string, account string, region string, resource_type string, resource_id string) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `cloud_provider` (String) The cloud service provider for the CRN (e.g., aws, gcp, azure, vmware).
1. `account` (String) The unique identifier for the cloud account where the resource is located.
1. `region` (String) The geographical region within the cloud provider's infrastructure where the resource is deployed. Use 'global' for globally scoped resources.
1. `resource_type` (String) The category or classification of the cloud resource (e.g., EC2, S3, MemoryDB).
1. `resource_id` (String) The unique identifier assigned to the specific cloud resource within its environment. The resource ID for an individual Cloud Asset can be found in the Falcon console within Cloud Security under Assets -> Cloud Inventory.
